serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-rug-pull-detector
serverInfo.description: MCP server that connects to another MCP server (stdio or Streamable HTTP), baselines its tools/list response, and detects 'rug pulls' — a tool silently changing description, schema, or annotations after it was already approved

tools.name: baseline_server
tools.description: Connect to an MCP server (stdio command or Streamable HTTP URL), read its current tools/list response, and store it as the trusted baseline for future drift checks.

command.description: Command to spawn for a stdio MCP server

env.description: Extra environment variables for the spawned process

cwd.description: Working directory for the spawned process

url.description: URL of a Streamable HTTP MCP server (alternative to command/args)

label.description: Stable identifier for this server, used to look up its baseline

tools.name: check_server
tools.description: Connect to an MCP server and compare its current tools/list response against the stored baseline, flagging any tool whose definition changed.

autoBaseline.description: Automatically capture a baseline if none exists yet (default: true)

tools.name: list_baselines
tools.description: List every server this scanner has a stored baseline for
